app.name: Seasons
app.summary: A clock for standby with a night scene of the season: snow, blossom, a summer night by the sea or pumpkins, with flakes and leaves drifting by.
app.saver_example: The time over a snowy night with falling snow
app.season_hint: Automatic follows the calendar; or keep one season all year.
app.start_hint: Astronomical: 20 March, 21 June, 22 September, 21 December. Meteorological: the first of March, June, September and December.
app.south_hint: Summer around Christmas: the automatic seasons turned round.
app.drift_hint: Snowflakes, petals, fireflies or leaves that move across the glass once a second.
app.scene_hint: The night scene behind the clock. Off: the clock and the drifting on black.
app.dim_hint: A veil over the picture while the screen's night levels hold.
app.date_hint: Day and month, such as 1.3. or 03-01. Empty: as Seasons start says.
